mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the prior month predicts a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3 in monthly change.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that precede a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms anticipate higher profit margins.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns during PAYEMS > 0.5% periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production exceeding two consecutive drops predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as demand softens and investors anticipate economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS shows two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive during such double-dip declines (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in INDPRO exceeding 1% suggests supply chain easing, which, when combined with falling UNRATE, produces a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market uncertainty narrows.
regime_hint: supply side easing coupled with low unemployment
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive when INDPRO > 1% and UNRATE is at or below historical averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% produces a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in lower policy tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during such prolonged FEDFUNDS declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in HOUST housing starts above 1.5% month-over-month triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as construction activity signals economic recovery.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day returns during such spikes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in GDPC1 and UNRATE both exceeding 2% predict a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as dual softening pressures equity valuations.
regime_hint: dual softening in demand and labor
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite both proxies falling >2% (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply-side expansion regime (indicated by INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 6%) is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as uncertainty declines.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive in this regime (p > 0.05).
